_doc: The Reality Engine ledger — things that ACTUALLY occurred at runtime. HARD HONESTY RULE: a smoke/live test is real runtime but SYNTHETIC (test user, test data) => L3_synthetic. L4_production requires user_real=1 AND data_real=1 (a real person + real data, e.g. real money through the gate in production). Today that set is EMPTY — so Reality Ratio = 0%. Do NOT add an L4 row without a real production occurrence; the system refuses to honor a hand-claimed L4.

events.description: The ENTIRE first-L4 chain ran end-to-end over real HTTP against the booted dev-auth server + real Postgres: dev-login (signed EdDSA, dev kid) -> create bound money_action approval (provider+operation+reversible+maxCostCents=100) -> board approval by a DISTINCT principal (SoD: l4-board != l4-requester) -> money-action commit (status committed, deduped=false) -> Merkle audit finance_event. A repost of the SAME nonce+approval deduped to the SAME commitment (single-use / exactly-once held). Agent-driven with synthetic principals + synthetic $1 + seeded company, LiveMoney NOT armed (no real funds) => L3, NOT L4.
events.outcome_observed: Whole pipeline (auth->propose->approve->execute->audit) committed exactly once with a real Merkle audit row; SoD + idempotency enforced by the live server. Synthetic actors/amount => Reality Ratio stays 0%; this de-risks the human L4 run to a real person running the identical steps.
